Accordion

Source: R/tier3-accordion.R
shad_accordion.Rd

A vertically stacked set of expandable items. input$<inputId> is the open value(s): a string/NULL (single) or a character vector (multiple).

Usage

shad_accordion(
  inputId,
  ...,
  type = c("single", "multiple"),
  collapsible = TRUE,
  value = NULL,
  class = NULL
)

shad_accordion_item(value, title, ...)

Arguments

inputId

Input id.

...

One or more shad_accordion_item().

type

"single" (default) or "multiple".

collapsible

For type = "single", allow closing the open item.

value

Item value.

class

Extra CSS classes.

title

Trigger text.

Value

An accordion tag.

See also

update_shad_accordion()

Other shadshiny tier-3 components: shad_alert_dialog(), shad_carousel(), shad_collapsible(), shad_command(), shad_command_palette(), shad_context_menu(), shad_dialog(), shad_drawer(), shad_dropdown_menu(), shad_hover_card(), shad_menu_parts, shad_menubar(), shad_message_scroller(), shad_navigation_menu(), shad_pagination(), shad_popover(), shad_resizable(), shad_scroll_area(), shad_sheet(), shad_sidebar_layout(), shad_tabs(), shad_tooltip()

Examples

shad_accordion("a",
  shad_accordion_item("item-1", "Is it accessible?", "Yes."),
  shad_accordion_item("item-2", "Is it styled?", "Yes."),
  value = "item-1")
#> <div data-shad="accordion" id="a" data-type="single" data-collapsible>
#>   <div class="shad-accordion__item" data-value="item-1" data-open>
#>     <button type="button" class="shad-accordion__trigger">
#>       Is it accessible?
#>       <svg class="shad-accordion__chevron" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg>
#>     </button>
#>     <div class="shad-accordion__content">
#>       <div class="shad-accordion__content-inner">Yes.</div>
#>     </div>
#>   </div>
#>   <div class="shad-accordion__item" data-value="item-2">
#>     <button type="button" class="shad-accordion__trigger">
#>       Is it styled?
#>       <svg class="shad-accordion__chevron" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg>
#>     </button>
#>     <div class="shad-accordion__content">
#>       <div class="shad-accordion__content-inner">Yes.</div>
#>     </div>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
